subject: english
question:
**Select the correct active voice form of the given sentence.**

All the prize winning books have been displayed on the tables.

options.text: We have to display all the prize winning books on the tables.
We are displaying all the prize winning books on the tables.
We have displayed all the prize winning books on the tables.
We will be displaying all the prize winning books on the tables.

solution:
The correct answer is 'We have displayed all the prize winning books on the tables.'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Passive Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it into Active Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence is as follows: 
 
 
• Subject + has/have + V3 + Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (Objective Case) + has/have + been + V3 + by + Object (Subjective Case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *We have finalized the site for our new factory. (Active Voice) *
 
• *The site for our new factory has been finalized by us. (Passive Voice)*
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is 'All the prize winning books' and the object of the given sentence is 'We (hidden)'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject. 
 
• And 'have been displayed' will be changed into 'have displayed'. 

 

Correct Sentence:__ *We have displayed all the prize winning books on the tables.*
